title: Soulbloomers
tagline: publish eco-friendly books & art cards as NFTs to join communities (eventually ecosystems & DAOs).
description:
I love nature, arts, neuro. I see the potential in blockchain to help protect and know the authentication of the production of the authors, artists, etc in unique ways where they truly enjoy building their community after selling the assets &// NFTs. I've seen DAOs that are inactive or ran by similar people who haven't brought up the visions.

Hoping to change that while bringing the human touch on certain parts of the world that matter, especially natural value changes in decision-making together throughout the journey. Thanks, with love and peace for the world we love.
how_its_made:
Soulbloomers was built from scratch in just a few hours using simple, accessible tools — a mix of web magic, creative design, and Hedera blockchain technology. The demo runs fully on the front end using HTML, CSS, and vanilla JavaScript, hosted through GitHub Pages for transparency and open-source access.

The NFT minting logic was first tested in the Hedera Playground, where the smart contract creates and mints eco-friendly NFTs using the Hedera Token Service (HTS). The NFT metadata is stored on Pinata (IPFS) for decentralised, sustainable storage.

It's added with a human touch of the arts that are hand-crafted and to be used as demo for the minted NFTs.
